name: wmkf_sitevisit-logistics
_comment: Additive Site Visit fields needed for round-trip format, IANA timezone, physical/virtual location, and immutable recipient reference identity. Runtime must not select them until the target passes exact preflight and this wave is explicitly applied.

attributes.description: How the Site Visit will occur.
IANA time-zone identifier used to interpret and round-trip the entered local Site Visit time.
Physical location, virtual meeting URL, or hybrid attendance instructions.

Server-owned versioned identity map for Site Visit organizer and attendee ActivityParty rows. Roster entries are keyed by immutable expertise_roster IDs; resolved names and addresses remain on ActivityParty.
